paragraphs: The Vito 108/109 CDI was part of the first-generation W638 Vito range, produced from 1996 to 2003. These early Vito models use the OM601/OM602 diesel engine family - a robust 2.2L to 2.7L four and five-cylinder unit that shares its basic architecture with other Mercedes commercial vehicles of the era. The Vito 108/109 CDI is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VITO 108 109 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the VITO 108 109 CDI from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
